purchase.content: Stop overspending on iRacing content you don’t need. With the iRacing Purchase Planner, you can analyze the series you've selected and see the full calendar with all tracks each week. Easily identify which tracks appear most frequently and decide which ones are worth buying based on your interests. Plan your iRacing season purchases smartly, save money, and stay competitive.

planner.title: Organize Your iRacing Calendar
planner.description: Plan your iRacing season with iRaceBuy's interactive calendar. Set rain alerts, mark your favorite races, and hide ones you’re not interested in for more efficient tracking.
planner.subtitle: Organize Your iRacing Calendar
planner.content: With the iRacing Calendar Organizer, you can easily select the series that interest you and customize your race season. Hide weeks from any series you don’t want to participate in to keep your calendar clean. Check rain probabilities instantly for each week and prepare for changing track conditions. Highlight your favorite weeks and never miss an important race. Take full control of your iRacing season and manage your races efficiently and personally.
planner.list.1: Get a clean and organized calendar
planner.list.2: See rain probabilities for each week instantly
planner.list.3: Highlight your favorite weeks from each series
planner.seoText1: With the iRaceBuy calendar, organizing your iRacing season has never been easier. Thanks to our features, you can: Set rain alerts: adjust the rain threshold and receive notifications when rainy conditions are predicted, so you’re prepared for every race. Mark favorites: select your favorite races and track them quickly. Hide races: remove races you’re not interested in, keeping your planning clear and focused on what matters.
planner.seoText2: Our interactive calendar lets you plan your season efficiently, save time, and maximize your iRacing experience. Both beginner drivers and advanced simracers can benefit from intelligent planning, avoiding surprises and optimizing every session.

contact.title: Let's Connect
contact.content: Hi! My name is Juanjo Mengual. I'm the person behind this website. If you have ideas, suggestions to improve iracebuy.com, or just want to collaborate, get in touch! Your feedback is very important and helps me improve this project for everyone.
contact.aboutMe: I’m a passionate iRacing driver who, like many others, spent a lot of time looking for purchase guides and planning each season properly. That’s when I realized there was a need for a clear, centralized, and easy-to-use tool, so I created iRaceBuy.com. I’m not especially fast (and my profile shows it 😅), but I am a safe, consistent driver, and above all, committed to the community. This project was born from real simracing experience, created for those of us who share this passion, with the sole goal of offering something truly useful to other simracers.
